purpose: Acceptance coverage for the final non-AWS delivery recording; this document is not execution evidence.
preconditions: Complete the relevant functionality and fresh acceptance gates before recording it as working
Coordinate with other tasks and establish exclusive ownership of one dedicated visible window and recorder
Follow the applicable recording authorization window and freshly identify the intended window
Use a new output directory; preserve historical and partial media
Keep private prompts, secrets, session cookies, provider keys and unrelated windows outside capture
Pin the build under test and distinguish a local build from the released production deployment

coverage.requiredObservation: Readable desktop/mobile typography, independent card heights, working route navigation and correct scroll reset
Explicit authentication state, disconnect and account/network changes revoke old UI results; failures do not become signed-in success
coverage.boundary: A mock wallet video does not prove an external wallet signature; signature evidence is a separate requirement

coverage.requiredObservation: An authenticated task-bound request proceeds from queued to a persisted plan readback; graph branches, node assignments and exact-version confirmation are visible
coverage.boundary: Queued, committed planning and approved planning do not imply completed Agent execution

coverage.requiredObservation: A previously persisted task can be read after reconnect; show the matching task/version and the separate restart acceptance record
coverage.boundary: A browser reload alone is not proof of a server restart or provider-side exactly-once execution

coverage.navigation: Open a real authorized task through its existing detail link
coverage.requiredObservation: Display P, symmetric deposits, fee, canonical asset and quote hash; both participants read the same quote; a changed/expired quote loses confirmation readiness
coverage.boundary: Quote confirmation is not payment, investment, yield accrual or a receipt

coverage.navigation: Use the task detail and explainable matching controls
coverage.requiredObservation: Role-scoped order actions, explicit current status, qualification constraints and matching evidence; pending oracle state does not select a random winner
coverage.boundary: No duplicate historical chain transactions or fabricated VRF fulfillment

coverage.requiredObservation: Visible Office navigation, actual Cocos rendering, desk selection, status filtering and desktop/mobile resize without clipped hit targets
coverage.boundary: Public demonstration desks stay labeled as demonstration data, not private live work

coverage.requiredObservation: Explain wallet/role prerequisites, conflict review and both outcome directions; identify the independently verified receipt/status evidence
coverage.boundary: Showing the form is not proof of settlement; historical receipts retain their original scope and date

coverage.requiredObservation: Authenticated permissions, review context and versions, self-review rejection, revocation/expired-session behavior, audit readback and clear unavailable states
coverage.boundary: Governance database actions are not cloud deployment, DAO voting or transfer of funds

coverage.requiredObservation: Current runtime architecture, readable evidence links, correct local/production/chain boundaries and clearly historical previous recordings

acceptance: Map each recorded case to a time range, observed result and build identity
Leave blocked or uncovered requirements explicitly incomplete rather than replacing them with demonstrations
Verify finalized media is playable and critical actions are legible at a deliberate pace
Record media hash and coverage results only after actual capture and review
Publish the new recording and its truthful coverage ledger without overwriting historical evidence
